We think brand is becoming infrastructure: one canonical source of truth that any system can query. Rainbrand is that brand layer - we’re creating the systems to make brand as wieldable as code.  
 

How it works

1. Ingest. Point Rainbrand at everything that defines your brand: website, decks, Figma, socials, codebases, and more.
2. Systemise. Rainbrand unifies it into one brand system - a canonical ontology of your brand.
3. Deploy anywhere. Call that system from every surface and generate every asset you need - ads, social, product shots, mockups, and full campaigns.

Built for agents

# Rainbrand – the brand layer for agents

Rainbrand turns brand into infrastructure that any agent, app, or platform can call.

Ray Fitzgerald

Rainbrand

Rainbrand — the brand layer for agents

AI has unlocked an abundance of software. But software is just one input into building a product and running a business - and as it's gotten cheap and fast, new limiting factors have emerged. Brand is one of them. Unlike software, brand isn't operable: it's scattered across decks, products, and tribal knowledge. There’s no system for brand, and nothing can actually call it, and so most of what gets shipped is off-brand by default. [...] Agents: marketing agents running campaigns, coding agents creating landing pages, e-commerce agents running brands - all calling Rainbrand over MCP.
 Products: use our API as the brand layer for any products that require brand context or assets for their customers.
 Brand and marketing operations: agencies and marketing teams call Rainbrand to automate on-brand asset creation inside their existing stack.
 Claude: use the Claude connector to create on-brand assets with all of your existing context.

Traction - We launched v1 in December and went viral. Since then we’ve generated over 175,000 on-brand assets for our customers.
